name: The Chancery Rosewood
positioning: All-suite hotel in the former US Embassy on Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, a Grade II-listed building designed by Eero Saarinen in 1960
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base steps from Bond Street and Oxford Street shopping
Food-focused travelers who want several restaurants and bars under one roof

facts.text: The Chancery Rosewood is an all-suite property with eight restaurants and bars.
The hotel is at 30 Grosvenor Square in London's Mayfair.
The hotel is steps from shopping on Bond Street and Oxford Street, with Selfridges a short walk away.
The Chancery Rosewood is Rosewood's second London hotel, alongside Rosewood London in Holborn.
Tobi Masa is a Japanese restaurant with an intimate omakase counter and a private dining room.
Jacqueline reimagines the British tradition of afternoon tea, with a collection of over 100 teas sourced from around the world.
Jacqueline sits just off the lobby.
Serra Restaurant & Bar serves Southern Mediterranean cuisine with family-style service.
Serra's interiors are by New York-based designers AvroKO.
GSQ is a day-to-night cafe with an expansive outdoor terrace that welcomes walk-in guests and offers takeaway.
Asaya Spa has treatment rooms, a pool, a sauna, a steam room, a hydrozone, a movement studio and a gym.
The fitness centre features Artis Luxury equipment and a TechnoGym reformer bed.

highlights.text: The hotel is set within the former US Embassy.
Eagle Bar is a rooftop bar with roof terraces that offer views of Grosvenor Square and Hyde Park.
The building was designed by Eero Saarinen in 1960 and is a Grade II-listed landmark.
Three new floors were added, made possible by the discovery of the original architect plans that included them.
Since the late 18th century this corner of Mayfair has been tied to notable Americans, starting with John Adams, who lived here as the first United States Minister.

considerations.text: Asaya Spa is on one of the basement levels.
The Private Dining Rooms, within Serra and Tobi Masa, seat up to 12 guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and central London location.
